messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: embeddings-service — elevated latency across region us-west-2. Severity: P1. Increase in 95/99 latency, errors ~3% for embed route. Link: https://monitoring.redwood/incident/2041009876
Alice (oncall): acked, I'm on it. collecting traces now.
Priya (sre): saw the spike correlate with a config push to kvcache eviction policy at ~2041009800. rolling a quick revert to previous eviction threshold.
Marco (eng-ml): hmm, model-side mem usage bumped on the 2.1 quantized variant around that time too. could be working set + more aggressive eviction thrashing KV and increasing tail latency.
Alice (oncall): running `curl -X POST https://ops/scale -d '{"pool":"embeddings","delta":2}'` to add capacity as temporary mitigation.
Ben (eng-runtime): scaling up nodes now, ETA ~2m. also pushing a runtime flag to disable prefix-merge batching for the embeddings route (should reduce lock contention).
Priya (sre): revert applied: `evict_threshold=0.6 -> 0.75` (rolled back). talking to runtime: eviction events dropped after revert. latency 95pct moving down from 2.3s -> 1.1s. errors down to 0.6%.
Clara (customer-success): any idea which tenants saw errors? customers on dedicated pools? I have a few onhold support tickets from two enterprise customers.
Dana (product): need customer-impact summary for the postmortem. prioritize outreach if any SLA breached.
Alice (oncall): quick list: tenant-zenpay (embeddings heavy), tenant-nimbus (batch inference) reported elevated latencies; both hosted in us-west-2 but on shared hosted pool. No data loss.
Priya (sre): logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T10:23:05Z] eviction loop: removed 12 shards, kv_unavailable=0.12
[2026-03-15T10:23:06Z] batch_scheduler: queue_depth spiked to 420, latency_ms=2300
[2026-03-15T10:23:07Z] rpc: timeout to model-host-5 (retry)
```
Ben (eng-runtime): rolling back the batching change now (flag off) — if that causes higher token cost we'll revert after stabilization.
Marco (eng-ml): as a safe fallback we can switch heavy traffic to the 2.0 model variant (slightly higher cost but more stable memory profile). request approval?
Dana (product): approve fallback for emergency only. coordinate comms with Clara.
Alice (oncall): switching route to 2.0 variant for zenpay traffic -> applied routing override.
Priya (sre): baseline after mitigations: 95pct ~0.9s, errors ~0.2% in last 10m. Stabilized. marking live incident mitigated. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident 2041009876 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem recommended.
Dana (product): ok schedule a 60m postmortem within 3 business days. we need action items and sizing for each.
Alice (oncall): proposed postmortem time: 2026-03-17 15:00 PDT. invite: eng-runtime, eng-ml, sre, product, cs.
Marco (eng-ml): I'll own model-side investigation. Action: confirm whether 2.1 quantized variant has a memory regression after the last churn. Estimate: S (2d investigation + 1 fix spike) — depends on root cause.
Priya (sre): I'll own runtime-kv analysis. Action: reproduce eviction threshold interplay with batch scheduling. Estimate: M (3d with benching work + 1 deployment).
Ben (eng-runtime): Action: add smarter backoff around batch-scheduler when queue_depth > X to prevent cascading evictions. Estimate: L (1 sprint + QA).
Dana (product): Action: customer communication and SLA check. Priority: P1 for zenpay and nimbus (outreach + credits if SLA breached). Estimate: S (half day for comms + decision).
Clara (customer-success): I'll draft emails and open support follow-ups for affected customers.
Alice (oncall): I'll add an action: add an automated mitigation playbook entry (runbook) for embeddings high-latency: steps to scale, revert eviction thr, and fallback to 2.0 variant. Estimate: S. Tie this to Q2 Reliability OKR (Reduce host-level P1s for embeddings by 50%).
Dana (product): marking priority: runtime fixes (Ben) = high, kv/sre probe (Priya) = high, model regression (Marco) = medium-high. We'll slot Ben's work into next sprint and Priya/Marco into Q2 planning.
Priya (sre): logging action items into the remediation board now: https://kanban.redwood/remediation/board/2041009876. Please add estimates and owners.
Marco (eng-ml): one more ask: we should add a model variant health metric to the console (memory pressure, evictions, per-variant 95pct latency). Estimate: M. Tie to Optimize product initiative.
Dana (product): agreed — add to Optimize roadmap as a stretch for Q2.
Alice (oncall): summary for postmortem doc: 1) Timeline + root cause hypothesis (eviction threshold change + model mem growth) 2) Mitigations performed (scale, revert, fallback) 3) Customer impact (tenants listed) 4) Action items (owners + estimates) 5) Follow-ups (dashboards, runbooks, roadmap tie-ins). I'll create the initial postmortem doc and link it here before the meeting.
Clara (customer-success): ping when postmortem doc is ready so I can tailor comms.
Ben (eng-runtime): noted. I'll prep a short changelist for the sprint planning session (priority: backoff + batch scheduler improvements).
Priya (sre): closing note: no evidence of data corruption, only availability/latency. tagging incident as 'mitigated with partial root cause, follow-up required'.
Dana (product): thanks all. good reactive work. Let's make sure action items have owners and timelines so this doesn't slip into backlog. :eyes:
